item.title: Basic Arcane Mage
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Arcane Mage is a flexible spellcaster built around Arcane abilities and Necromancy buffs.

The build uses mobility and positioning to stay alive while dealing strong spell damage. Wrestling and Parrying provide additional defensive options.

Aspect Options

Recommended Aspect options include:

  • Blood Armor
  • Eldritch Armor
  • Void Armor
  • Arcane Staff

Arcane equipment provides the primary offensive focus of the build.

Link Options

Recommended Chain Links include:

  • Damage to Diseased
  • Spell Aspect Chance
  • Spell Aspect Modifier

These improve the build’s spell damage and Aspect performance.

item.title: Basic Dexxer
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Dexxer is a simple and reliable melee template built around Chivalry, weapon damage, and strong self-sustain.

It can be adapted to several different weapon styles, making it a good starting point for players who want a traditional melee character without committing to a highly specialized setup.

Aspect Options

Recommended Aspect options include:

  • Water
  • Earth
  • Fire
  • Discipline
  • Holy

The best choice depends on the weapon and playstyle being used.

item.title: Basic Summoner
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Summoner is a straightforward mage designed around letting summoned creatures handle the frontline while you support them with Necromancy and Magery.

It is an accessible starting point for players looking to build a dedicated summoner without relying on complicated mechanics.

Aspect Options

Recommended Aspect options include:

  • Void
  • Death
  • Eldritch

These provide different ways to improve the offensive and defensive capabilities of the build.

Link Options

Chain Links are not a major requirement for this build.

item.title: Mad Shepherd
item.description:
Overview

This is a general-purpose Tamer build designed for PvM and farming. It combines a strong tamed creature with melee damage and utility skills to provide a flexible and relatively inexpensive farming setup.

The build is intended to be easy to get started with while still providing enough room to improve as better equipment, aspects, and chain links become available.

Aspect Options

There are several viable aspect choices depending on how you want to play the build.
